propositions: Test workers race on a shared git index: two concurrent add/commit pairs interleave such that the first commit sweeps both staged files, leaving the second commit with nothing to stage and returning rc=1 with empty stderr.
The advisory lock in _with_index_lock_retry wraps individual run_git_write calls but does not serialize the add/commit pair, allowing the interleaving that causes the race.
Worker assertion reports only r.stderr and omits the failing command name and git stdout, making empty-stderr failures like 'nothing to commit' undiagnosable from CI logs.
Test expects both concurrent writers to exit rc=0 and both commits to be present in git log, but the current test design (bare whole-index commits) can violate this under load.
Fix: each worker commits its own pathspec instead of the whole index, ensuring a writer that loses the interleaving still has its own staged change to commit and does not see 'nothing to commit'.
Observability improvement: worker assertions should name their command and include both stdout and stderr, not just stderr, for self-diagnosing failures.
